name: exyconn-portal-plus-website
description: Exyconn monorepo — portal (GraphQL server + React admin UI) and the public Astro website.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server --filter exyconn-portal-ui --filter exyconn --filter exyconn-tracker-app --parallel run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server --filter exyconn-portal-ui --filter exyconn --filter exyconn-tracker-app --parallel run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server --filter exyconn-portal-ui --filter exyconn --filter exyconn-tracker-app --parallel run typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server --filter exyconn-portal-ui --filter exyconn --parallel run format
scripts.test: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server --filter exyconn-portal-ui --filter exyconn-tracker-app --parallel run test
scripts.codegen: pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-server run codegen && pnpm --filter exyconn-portal-ui run codegen
